# Represent Commercial

> Principal-led commercial property advisory acting for property owners, buyers and tenants, never for vendors. Buyer’s agency across Brisbane, South East Queensland and regional Queensland. Commercial property management, leasing and tenant representation in Brisbane. Office, retail and industrial. Typically working with commercial assets valued from $1 million to $10 million. Led by Nick O'Toole, Founder and Director, with 20+ years of owner-side commercial property experience. Real Estate Agent Licence 4949809.

## Brand
- Master brand: Exclusively on your side of the table.

## Services
1. Commercial Property Management and Asset Management: property management delivered with an asset-management mindset, Brisbane
2. Commercial Property Leasing: owner-side leasing of vacant commercial space, Brisbane
3. Buyer’s Agency and Acquisition Advisory: independent buyer representation for investors and owner-occupiers across Queensland, never acting for the vendor
4. Commercial Tenant Representation: tenant-side representation for Brisbane industrial, office and retail tenants
